name: Lina Gálvez - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the Council to take a strong EU position at a United Nations meeting in March 2026 on women's rights. It wants the EU to push for women and girls to have real access to justice everywhere: legal aid, fair courts, protection from violence, and more women as judges. It also calls for defending abortion and sexual health rights, supporting groups that help women, and standing firm against attempts to weaken gender equality. This is a set of recommendations, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the Council, not binding rules.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments negotiating at the UN meeting, and women and girls worldwide.
- **What happens next:** The Council decides whether to use these priorities in the March 2026 talks.
